name: Cloud
author: PyCmd
description: Supabase and Firebase, over their REST APIs, with nothing to install. Connect a project once and reach it from a script, a server, the console or the panel: rows and documents, sign-up and sign-in, storage up and down, the Realtime Database and Postgres functions. The client is pycmd_cloud, importable from anything you write.
